_help: Defaults for new jobs; flags on `npm run video -- start` override them. format: landscape (16:9 long-form) or vertical (9:16 reels and shorts). length: seconds, or null for the whole recording; with supplied audio it trims longer recordings, for a generated script it is the target duration. verticalMaxSeconds: vertical jobs longer than this get a warning. fps: 24, 30 or 60. channelTheme: the design theme every film starts from (film.json theme format), or null to let each film choose freely.
